Treatment overview

What is a HydraFacial?

A HydraFacial is a medical-grade facial that deep-cleans, exfoliates, extracts and hydrates your skin in one go. Instead of scrubbing and squeezing, it uses a special spiral tip that works like a tiny vortex: it loosens dirt and dead skin, gently suctions it out of your pores and, at the same time, feeds the skin with serums.

The result is skin that is cleaner, smoother and more hydrated than any regular facial can manage, without redness or peeling. That's why it's loved by people who want a glow before an event, and by anyone who wants healthier skin month after month.

Read more: Original HydraFacial vs "hydra" facials

Many clinics and salons now offer "hydra" style facials on generic machines. The Original HydraFacial is different in a few important ways:

  • Patented Vortex-Fusion technology that cleans and delivers serums at the same time.
  • Single-use, branded tips for each client, for better hygiene.
  • HydraFacial's own serums and boosters, made for the system.
  • Consistent, proven results from a device used in clinics around the world.

At Facelit we use the genuine HydraFacial Elite.

1. Cleanse & peelLifts away dead skin and opens up pores.
2. Extract & hydratePainless vortex suction clears pores while hydrating.
3. Fuse & protectAntioxidants and peptides soak in for lasting glow.

Our technology

Meet the Original HydraFacial Elite

Not every "hydra facial" is a HydraFacial. We use the genuine machine, the same technology trusted by skin clinics worldwide.

US FDA-cleared

The HydraFacial Elite uses patented Vortex-Fusion technology to cleanse, exfoliate, extract and hydrate at the same time. Spiral tips create a vortex that loosens impurities and suctions them away while infusing the skin with HydraFacial serums and boosters chosen for your skin.

The three HydraFacial steps

A gentle cleansing serum and resurfacing tip lift away dead skin cells and surface oil. A mild acid peel then loosens what's inside your pores, without stinging or peeling afterwards.

  • Removes the dull top layer
  • Softens blackheads and debris
  • Gentle enough for sensitive skin
What you feel: a cool, gentle glide
Time: about 10 minutes

The vortex tip suctions out blackheads, oil and impurities, painlessly. While it works, it also bathes the skin in hydrating serums, so skin never feels stripped.

  • No squeezing or pressing
  • Visibly cleaner pores
  • Hydrates while it cleans
What you feel: light suction, like a tiny vacuum
Time: about 10 minutes

Antioxidants, peptides and hyaluronic acid are infused deep into the freshly cleaned skin to plump, protect and give that signature glow.

  • Plumper, dewy skin
  • Antioxidant protection
  • Glow that lasts days
What you feel: cool and soothing
Time: about 10 minutes

Your HydraFacial can be tailored with extras chosen by your doctor.

  • Boosters for brightening, fine lines or extra hydration
  • Detox and circulation steps in our Hydra Platinum
  • Combination plans with peels, exosomes or skin boosters
Adds: 10 to 20 minutes
Downtime: none

A HydraFacial does more in 30 minutes than most facials do in an hour.

Clean, Clear Pores

Instant Glow

More Even Tone

Fewer Breakouts

  • Plumper, softer skin

Your appointment

HydraFacial Procedure: Step by Step

A short skin check helps us choose the right serums and boosters for you.

  • Our team looks at your skin and asks about your concerns, allergies and medicines.
  • Make sure there's no infection, cut, bruise or active cold sore on the area.
  • Avoid waxing, bleaching and threading on the face for 3 to 5 days before.
  • Pause retinoids and strong acids 2 to 3 days before.
  • Come with clean skin if you can. We'll remove any makeup anyway.

Lie back and relax. Most people find it soothing.

  • Your face is cleansed and gently exfoliated with the resurfacing tip.
  • A mild peel loosens oil and debris in your pores.
  • The vortex tip painlessly suctions out blackheads and impurities.
  • Hydrating serums are infused at the same time.
  • Antioxidants, peptides and any booster are fused into the skin.
  • Sunscreen is applied before you leave.

You can go straight back to your day. The full aftercare plan is below.

  • Skin may look a little pink for up to an hour.
  • Avoid makeup for 6 to 12 hours so the serums keep working.
  • Skip saunas, steam rooms and heavy workouts for 24 hours.
  • Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen every day.
  • Follow the home routine your doctor suggests for longer-lasting results.

Results

HydraFacial Results Timeline

HydraFacial works instantly, and regular sessions make the results last longer.

  1. Right after

    Instant glow

    Skin looks brighter, cleaner and more hydrated as soon as you sit up.

  2. Day 1–3

    Peak glow

    Makeup goes on smoothly and skin feels soft and bouncy.

  3. Week 1

    Clearer pores

    Pores look cleaner and skin stays less oily.

  4. Monthly sessions

    Lasting change

    Tone, texture and hydration keep improving with regular treatments.

A good fit if you

  • Want an instant glow with no downtime
  • Have blackheads, oily or congested skin
  • Have dull, dry or dehydrated skin
  • Want regular, gentle skin maintenance

Wait if you have

  • Active rash, sunburn or open wounds
  • Very inflamed or cystic acne
  • Active cold sores
  • Recent strong peel or laser (check with us)

Aftercare

HydraFacial Aftercare

Easy aftercare helps your glow last longer.

Do

  • Leave the serums on your skin
  • Drink plenty of water
  • Use sunscreen if you go out
  • Sleep on a clean pillowcase

Avoid

  • Makeup for 6 to 12 hours
  • Sauna, steam and hot yoga
  • Heavy workouts
  • Touching your face

Do

  • Use a gentle cleanser
  • Moisturise morning and night
  • Wear SPF 30 to 50 daily
  • Keep up your water intake

Avoid

  • Retinoids and acids for 48 hours
  • Scrubs and face brushes
  • Waxing or threading the face
  • Chlorinated pools for 24 hours

Morning

  • Gentle cleanser
  • Hydrating or vitamin C serum
  • Light moisturiser
  • Sunscreen, reapplied outdoors

Night

  • Double cleanse if you wear makeup
  • Treatment serum your doctor suggests
  • Moisturiser
  • Book your next HydraFacial in about 4 weeks

Your skin type

HydraFacial for Every Skin Type

Oily & acne-prone skin
Great for oily skin. Extraction clears out congestion and a clarifying serum helps control oil. We avoid working over very inflamed acne.
Dry & dehydrated skin
One of the best treatments for dry skin. Hyaluronic acid serums leave skin plump and comfortable.
Sensitive skin
Gentle enough for most sensitive skin. We adjust the peel strength and choose calming serums.
Combination skin
We can spend more time extracting the oily T-zone and focus on hydration on the drier cheeks.
Indian and darker skin tones
Very safe for darker skin. There's no harsh scrubbing or heat, so the risk of pigmentation is very low.

Safety first

HydraFacial Side Effects and Precautions

HydraFacial is one of the gentlest skin treatments available. Here's what to know.

Common and temporary

  • Slight pinkness for up to an hour
  • Mild tingling during the peel step
  • Skin feeling a little tight for a few hours
  • Rarely, a small breakout as pores clear out

Tell us first if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Are allergic to aspirin or salicylates
  • Use isotretinoin, retinoids or strong acids
  • Have rosacea, active rash or cold sores
  • Had a laser, peel or injectables in the last 2 weeks

Questions

HydraFacial FAQs

What is the difference between the Original HydraFacial and other hydra facials?
Many salons offer "hydra" style facials using generic machines. The Original HydraFacial uses a patented Vortex-Fusion delivery system, single-use tips and HydraFacial's own serums. At Facelit we use the genuine HydraFacial Elite.
Is HydraFacial painful?
No. Most people find it relaxing. The extraction feels like a gentle suction or a light tingle, and there is no squeezing.
How long does a HydraFacial take?
About 30 to 45 minutes for the HydraFacial Elite. Hydra Platinum takes up to an hour.
Is there any downtime?
None. Your skin may look slightly pink for an hour or so, but most people go straight back to work or out for the evening.
How often should I get a HydraFacial?
Once a month is ideal, as it matches your skin's natural renewal cycle. For specific concerns like congested pores or pigmentation, we may suggest 3 to 6 sessions 2 to 4 weeks apart.
When will I see results?
Straight away. Skin looks brighter and feels smoother as soon as the session ends, and the glow usually lasts 5 to 7 days. Regular sessions build longer-lasting improvements.
Is HydraFacial safe for Indian skin?
Yes. It is gentle, uses no harsh scrubbing and has a very low risk of pigmentation, so it suits all Indian skin tones.
Can I get a HydraFacial if I have acne?
Yes for mild acne, blackheads and congestion. If you have very inflamed or cystic acne, our doctor will treat that first and plan HydraFacials once the skin is calmer.
Can I get a HydraFacial during pregnancy?
Usually yes, with some changes. We avoid certain ingredients like salicylic acid. Always tell us if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Should I get a HydraFacial before my wedding?
Yes, it is one of the most popular pre-bridal treatments. Book your last session 2 to 3 days before the wedding for the best glow, and start a series 2 to 3 months ahead for best results.
Can HydraFacial be combined with other treatments?
Yes. It pairs well with chemical peels, exosomes, skin boosters and laser treatments. Your doctor will plan the timing so they work together.
Is the HydraFacial machine FDA-cleared?
Yes. The HydraFacial technology we use is US FDA-cleared, and every session follows strict hygiene with single-use tips.
Where can I get the Original HydraFacial in Kerala?
